title: Spotted in another sub
content: https://preview.redd.it/hwmu2wdll02e1.jpg?width=1080&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=64e8512206acacd6753887ca269b040fffe6d927 Do these look familiar to anyone else? I've been up and down these stairs more times than I can count. Mine usually have a solid red carpet rather than the pattern, otherwise spot on. Sometimes it takes a bit of climbing over something or up a ladder to get to the stairs. Once I reached the top and found an attic with a shelf of tiny books. A lot of the time these are close to the plush guest rooms and the large banquet hall.
